verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents serverless, usage-based billing or published per-unit costs for Helix Cloud. The docs show plan-based database creation (`--plan <plan>`) and cluster commands, and a community comment describes pricing starting around $600/mo, which suggests fixed plans rather than metered pricing. Pricing model is a fair question for a cloud database, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pay serverless usage-based pricing with transparent per-unit costs instead of provisioning fixed clusters
